description: This file defines a class 'stock_graph' for generating stock graphs as PDF reports using the pychart library, including methods for adding data, drawing the graph, and closing the report.

classes.name: stock_graph
classes.description: A class for creating stock level graphs as PDF reports, with methods to add data, render the graph, and close the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the stock_graph object, setting up the canvas and data structures.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds stock data for a specific product and updates min/max date values.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Generates the stock graph PDF with the accumulated data.
